text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian Energy has agreed to allow Ignalina Nuclear power plant to look for buyers of energy abroad but the price for exported energy will have to be approved by the economy ministry.

- Former foreign minister Povilas Gylys criticised parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis, who said he did not understand the purpose of the September 5-6 international conference in Vilnius on peaceful coexistence and good neighbourly relations.
